digitalocean.name: DigitalOcean
digitalocean.tagline: Droplets, VPCs and managed Kubernetes on a simple cloud.
digitalocean.tokenHelp: Create a personal access token with read and write access. Custom scopes need the exact scopes listed in the Permissions panel.

vultr.name: Vultr
vultr.tagline: 遍布全球多个城市的云计算与裸金属服务。

terms.vocab: 实例, 区域, 套餐

vultr.tokenHelp: 在 Account、API 下创建 API 密钥，并把此服务器的地址加入其访问控制列表。

hetzner.name: Hetzner Cloud
hetzner.tagline: Fast, low cost servers in European and US locations.
hetzner.tokenHelp: Create an API token inside the Hetzner project with read and write permission. Tokens have no finer scopes.

aws.name: Amazon Web Services
aws.tagline: EC2 instances across AWS Regions, with IAM controlling access.

terms.vocab: EC2 instances, Regions, VPCs, Security groups, IAM

aws.tokenHelp: Use an IAM user access key, an assumed role or this control plane's own identity, with the EC2 actions Levelrail needs.

azure.name: Microsoft Azure
azure.tagline: Virtual machines organised by subscription and resource group.
azure.tokenHelp: Register a service principal and give it a role on the subscription or resource group you want Levelrail to use.

gcp.name: Google Cloud
gcp.tagline: VM instances in Google Cloud projects and zones.
gcp.tokenHelp: Use a service account key or workload identity with Compute Engine access on the project.

oracle.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
oracle.tagline: Compute instances and Flex shapes in compartments.

terms.vocab: Compute instances, Compartments, Availability domains, Shapes (Flex)

oracle.tokenHelp: Add an API signing key to your user, then allow it to manage instances in the compartment Levelrail uses.

custom.name: Custom data center
custom.tagline: Hosts you run yourself, enrolled by hand.
custom.tokenHelp: There is no cloud API here, so no token is needed. Levelrail only records the label and location.
